source.accroche: Recovery Tierlist For Optimal Health (Science based)

legendes.en: recovery is where you actually get fitter 🛌 #recovery #running #health #biohacking #fitness

notes: Full test du 24/11 (boîte vide, 5 livraisons calculées : 1 compte du label depuis le 24/11 ; aucun post neuf du compte modèle) : « Recovery Tierlist For Optimal Health (Science based) », sa famille à 130 k (21/10) ; éléments à nous ; `source` gardée pour mémoire, non envoyée. Croquis de couverture neuf (recup.jpg, Seedream). Slide Atala (11) : le second A tier « Easy Recovery Runs », une coureuse de la banque et le logo d'Atala. Texte selon placement_atala : titre de 6 mots → voix TOUCHE PERSO (« I let a running coach app like Atala… ») ; un seul argument : les jours faciles prévus dans la semaine ; version « cta E' ». Faits : l'adaptation se fait pendant la récupération (principe de surcompensation) ; le manque de sommeil nuit à la récupération et à la performance (Fullagar et al., Sports Med 2015) ; protéines et glucides après l'effort pour reconstruire et refaire les réserves (ISSN, Kerksick et al. 2017) ; l'immersion froide après chaque séance peut atténuer certains gains de force (Roberts et al., J Physiol 2015) ; une déshydratation légère baisse humeur et vigilance (Armstrong 2012) ; l'hormone de croissance est surtout sécrétée en sommeil profond. Rien de médical. Photos : banque de l'OS, aucune célébrité, aucune marque lisible.

paragraphes: Your body doesn't get fitter during the session. It adapts in the hours and days after, when it repairs what the training broke down.
Hard every day means you never get those hours. More effort, less progress.
Most of your repair work happens while you sleep. Cut it short and your muscles, mood and focus all pay for it the next day.
No recovery trick here can make up for a short night.
After training, your muscles need protein and carbs to rebuild and refill. An iced coffee gives them almost nothing to work with.
Fine as a treat. It lands in D when it's the only thing you have until dinner.

en.nom: A Full Day On The Sofa
paragraphes: Total rest feels like recovery, but lying still all day leaves you stiffer and heavier the next morning.
Rest days work better with some gentle movement.
Cold water can ease soreness and make you feel fresh again after a hard session.
Used straight after every workout, it may blunt some of the gains you trained for. Nice, not essential.
A few minutes of stretching helps you feel loose and makes the next session easier to start.
It feels good, but on its own it does far less for recovery than most people think.
You lose water with every session, and even mild dehydration leaves you tired and less sharp.
Simple and cheap. It's not A tier only because most people already get close enough.
Protein to rebuild muscle, carbs to refill your energy. That's what your body recovers with.
It misses A tier because the timing matters much less than eating well across the day.
An easy walk gets blood moving through tired legs without adding any real stress to your body.
It's the easiest way to recover faster, and it gets you outside in daylight too.
A slow, short run keeps your legs moving and builds your aerobic base without adding much fatigue.
Keep them truly slow. I let a running coach app like Atala plan which days stay easy.

en.nom: Seven To Nine Hours Of Sleep
paragraphes: Deep sleep is when your body releases growth hormone and does most of its repair work.
Nothing on this list comes close. It's free, and it makes every other habit work better.
